groups.title: hand 扌 手
groups.note: Three strokes on the left, or 手 below: a hand.

chars.story: A hand under a man's elbow to steady him: help up.

chars.parts: 扌 hand + 穴 cave + 乙 hook
chars.story: A hand makes a hole in the ground: dig.
A hand held up to stop the blow: keep it off.
chars.note: 擋 became 挡. 挡风玻璃 is a 'windshield'.

chars.story: A hand pushes the boundary out wider: expand.
chars.note: Also 'to make a rubbing' from a stone.

chars.parts: 扌 hand + 九 nine + 力 strength
chars.story: A hand puts its whole strength into a throw: toss.
chars.note: 拋 became 抛; 抛弃 'abandon' is the common word.

chars.story: A hand pulls a cover over to hide it: conceal.
chars.note: Cover or hide, often a fault.

chars.story: A hand passes lightly over a surface: caress.
chars.note: 撫 became 抚. 抚养 is 'to bring up a child'.

chars.story: A hand darts out quickly: nimble.
chars.note: 㨗 is an old form; 捷 is standard.

chars.story: A hand curled tight: a fist.

groups.title: water 氵
groups.note: Three drops: liquids and where they run.

chars.story: Water that comes out when you work hard: sweat.
chars.note: Also the word for a Khan; 'sweat' is the common sense.

chars.story: Where the guest reaches the water: the water's edge.
Moving through water on and on: swim.
Water slipping out through a gap: a leak, a secret told.
Water holds a thing up on its surface: float.
Soil well watered: fertile.
Fish in the water: a fisherman at work.
The heart finds the fit: exactly right.
chars.note: Used for 'just so' timing or fit.

chars.story: A heart moved by another's lot: pity.
A heart that nourishes others: compassionate.
A gentle press on the heart to calm it: console.
An ear that catches every word: clever.

chars.parts: 春 spring + 虫 insect + 虫 insect
chars.story: Insects wriggling blindly in spring: stupid.
chars.note: A rude word; use with care.

chars.story: The sun comes up and things become clear: dawn.
chars.note: Also 'to know' in 晓得 and 知晓. 曉 became 晓.

chars.story: A heart pulled two ways: confused.
Words with nothing in them: a lie.

chars.parts: 大 big person + 卉 plants
chars.story: A man running through the plants: rush.
Walking toward a place: go to.
chars.note: Formal 'go to' a place or event.

chars.story: The foot loses its footing: tumble.
The body shrinks behind something: dodge.
Walking aside to let another go first: yield.
chars.note: 遜 became 逊. Also 'inferior': 逊色 'not as good'; 谦逊 'modest'.

chars.story: Walking up to a runner and laying hands on him: apprehend.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'catch up'. In modern use it appears mostly in 逮捕 'arrest'.

chars.story: A beast that hunts well in packs: a wolf.
chars.note: 狼狈 'in a mess' is a famous idiom.

chars.story: An animal able to haul its own weight: a bear.
chars.note: 熊猫 'panda' is the common word.

chars.parts: 周 all around + 隹 bird
chars.story: A bird's beak picking round and round: carve.
chars.note: 鵰 'eagle' became 雕; the carving sense is the common one.

chars.story: A beast charging in: fierce.

groups.title: sickness 疒
groups.note: A leaning sick-bed: illness and pain.

chars.parts: 疒 sickness + 品 + 山 mountain
chars.story: A sickness heaped up in lumps like a mountain: cancer.
chars.note: The 品 stands for many lumps.

chars.story: A sick, sore spot: it hurts.
chars.note: 心疼 is 'heart-hurts': to feel sorry for or to love dearly.

chars.parts: 尸 body + 并 side by side
chars.story: A body-sized board stood up as a screen.
chars.note: A screen in the room or on a phone.

chars.story: Water from the body: urine.
Steps taken to drive the emperor's carriage: imperial.
chars.note: 禦 'defend' merged into 御; 防御 'defense' is the common word.

chars.story: A spoon points to the heart of the dish: the point.

chars.parts: 尸 + 共 together + 殳 weapon
chars.story: A great building where all gather together: a palace hall.
chars.note: 殿下 is how you address a prince.

chars.story: A hand picking beans for the family: uncle.
The far hem of a robe: those who come last.
chars.note: Seen in 华裔 'person of Chinese descent'.

chars.parts: 日 sun + 比 side by side
chars.story: Siblings side by side in the sun: the city of Kunming.
chars.note: Seen mostly in 昆虫 and the city of Kunming. Also 昆虫 'insect'; the old sense 'elder brother' is rare.

chars.story: A cow led to the altar in the west: a sacrifice.
chars.note: Only appears in 牺牲 and its relatives. 犧 became 牺.

chars.story: Someone goes off with your goods using strength: seize by force.
A shape cut short: falling short of full.
chars.note: 幸亏 'luckily' and 吃亏 'come off worse' are the common uses.

chars.story: A knife trims a thing to size: pare.
Ice that bites: to bully or abuse.
chars.note: 凌晨 'before dawn' is the time word.

chars.story: A tree with a red mark cut into its heart: vermilion.
Two reds blazing together: awe-inspiring.
chars.note: Also a unit, hertz, in 赫兹.

chars.story: Light glinting off a pheasant's feathers: dazzling.

groups.title: grain 禾 米
groups.note: Grain and what is made from it.

chars.story: Rice or flour pressed into a soft cake.
chars.note: 年糕 is the New Year rice cake.

chars.story: Tall stalks of grain, cut rough: a draft.
Rice picked clean of husks: pure.
Wooden bars along an edge: a railing.
chars.note: 欄 became 栏. 'Column' in a newspaper.

chars.story: Wooden rungs you climb: a ladder.
A young wooden spear shaft that bends: supple.
Bundles of fuel, then the pay for fetching them: salary.

chars.parts: 艹 grass + 氵 water + 尃
chars.story: Grass leaves pressed flat: thin.
chars.note: Also 'meager' in 薄弱 and 'mint' in 薄荷.

chars.story: Green shoots in a field: a seedling.
chars.note: 疫苗 'vaccine' is the common word.

chars.story: A mouth calling out for others to act: implore.
A mouth sends something down to the ground: spit.
A stone that pulls iron: magnetic.
A mountain made of stone: a cliff.
A building with a lean-to roof where ancestors are honored: shrine.
chars.note: 廟 became 庙; the right side was simplified.

chars.story: A house with only the bare minimum: inexpensive.
A small room tucked away: the toilet.
A great building with a summer breeze through it.
chars.note: 廈 became 厦. Also the city name Xiamen.

chars.story: A clay vessel with a neck: a bottle.
chars.note: Also a counter for bottled things.

chars.story: A hard skin like jade: glass.
A small craft: a boat.
A roof over a door, grain inside: a granary.
chars.note: 倉 became 仓. 仓促 'hasty' is another common use.

chars.story: White crust left in a dish: salt.
A metal bit boring into rock: drill.
The gas the sheep also breathes: oxygen.
Vapor spread through a room: its mood.
Threads laid side by side: lines.
Threads twisted together: entangle.
A little girl, dolled up: a baby.
Flesh growing within: a fetus.
chars.note: 轮胎 'tire' is the common word.

chars.story: A span of years drawn out long: long life.
chars.note: 壽 became 寿. Also 'birthday' in 祝寿.

chars.story: Pour a little more water in: add on.
chars.note: Add to what is already there.

chars.story: Earth shovelled into a hole till it is full.
A hand against something unyielding: hardship.
A figure with air blowing through: crisp and fresh.
chars.note: Cool or open, in speech and feeling.

chars.story: A curling line that leads on: thereupon.
chars.note: A literary 'then'. 木乃伊 'mummy' is a borrowed word.

chars.parts: - a well's wooden frame seen from above
chars.story: The wooden frame of a well, seen from above.
chars.note: Also the shape inside 讲 and 进.

chars.parts: - a hand with a dot marking a thumb's width
chars.story: A hand with a dot at the wrist: an inch.
chars.note: 分寸 'a sense of limits' is a common idiom.

chars.parts: - a person with a clan banner
chars.story: A person bearing a clan's banner: a clan name.
chars.note: Surname marker, as in 张氏.

chars.story: A tree beside the lake: Hangzhou.
chars.note: A place-name character: Hangzhou, the city.

chars.story: A bird bursting out of the rain: suddenly.
A grass of the sands: used in foreign names.
chars.note: A name character: 莎士比亚 is Shakespeare.

chars.parts: 艹 grass + 幺 thread + 幺 thread
chars.story: Grass and two threads: 'this one here'.
chars.note: A transliteration character in 赫兹 and 华尔兹.

chars.story: A white cloth: a handkerchief.
A person quietly checking: scout.
Two people: both.

chars.parts: 亻 person + 凡 ordinary + 巾 cloth
chars.story: A person wearing an ornament at the belt.
chars.note: Modern use is 钦佩 and 佩服 'admire'.

chars.story: A person you can't forgive: hatred.

sentences.en: The yacht sailed around a buoy.

sentences.zh: 这座雕像和真人的尺寸一样。
sentences.en: This statue is as large as life.

sentences.zh: 没有男人能够抵挡女人的诱惑。
sentences.en: No man can resist the lure of a woman.

sentences.zh: 摩天大厦里的电梯是至关重要的。
sentences.en: The elevators in a skyscraper are vital systems.

sentences.zh: 再走一步的话，你就已经跌下楼梯了。
sentences.en: Another step, and you would have fallen down the stairs.

sentences.zh: 不赶时间的人们站在自动扶梯的右边。
sentences.en: People who are not in a hurry stand on the right side of the escalator.

sentences.zh: 他不知道《罗密欧与朱丽叶》是莎士比亚写的。
sentences.en: He didn't know Shakespeare wrote Romeo and Juliet.

sentences.zh: 为躲避风暴，我们躲到了附近的一个谷仓内。
sentences.en: We took refuge from the storm in a nearby barn.

sentences.zh: 我没在等到你的回应之前添加了句子，真是糟糕。
sentences.en: Too bad I didn't wait for your response before I added the sentences.

sentences.zh: 那家馆子物美价廉，美中不足的是他们糟糕的位置。
sentences.en: That place's food is great, and their prices are good, but the fly in the ointment is their terrible location.
